summary: Frontend-only regression completed on public URL. TypeScript compile and production build pass; core desktop/mobile navigation, search, entity, save/remove, timeline, methodology, and responsive checks largely pass. Main blocker found in editorial login integration.

integration_issues.issue: Valid provided credentials could not authenticate; UI shows 'Origem não autorizada' and network returns 403 on /api/v1/auth/login.

action_items: Fix editorial auth origin handling for public preview domain so provided editor credentials can sign in (403 on /api/v1/auth/login).
After auth fix, retest read-only private editorial tabs (fila/entidades/fontes) using same credentials.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md with current valid accounts for future test agents.
critical_code_review_comments: Build safety is good: yarn tsc --noEmit and yarn build both pass after redesign.
Category count rendering uses truthy check (stats?.types?.[id]) in Explore.tsx; if any real category count is 0, UI will show 'A aguardar evidência' instead of '00 entidades documentadas'.
Timeline rendering has no explicit empty-state fallback; if /timeline ever returns empty, section becomes visually sparse without user guidance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Executed Playwright checks on external URL for desktop and mobile (390/360). Verified no horizontal overflow at 390/360, mobile bottom nav works, desktop sidebar nav hidden on mobile, menu closes via Escape, autocomplete stays within viewport, save/remove flow works, and world/category/entity navigations work. Editorial login blocked by 403 'Origem não autorizada', so private tabs could not be validated in this run.
rca of the issue: Repro: open /redacao -> fill editor@viarchive.pt / xuToEVZpqyVGmomzaP7x -> submit. Result: inline error 'Origem não autorizada'; browser console shows 403 on /api/v1/auth/login. Likely root cause is backend origin validation/CORS/allowed-origin mismatch for this preview execution context rather than credential format itself. Mitigation: verify allowed origins list and auth origin checks include current preview domain/protocol exactly, then retest login and read-only tab access.
